plan.summary: The cache size can now be set with the `CACHE_MB` environment variable. `cacheConfig` reads and parses it. It uses the value only when it is a finite number greater than zero. Otherwise it falls back to `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`.
plan.riskRationale: Small, local change to config parsing with a safe fallback. Invalid input cannot change behavior from the default.
plan.storyArc: One change: `cacheConfig` now takes the cache size from `CACHE_MB` and keeps the old default for missing or invalid values.

topics.title: Read cache size from CACHE_MB with a safe default
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `cacheConfig` choose the cache size, and what happens for missing or invalid `CACHE_MB`? Verify in the source that `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES` is the fallback and that no other caller depends on the old fixed value.
